name: PvP Power applies against creatures only in the High-Risk open world
contract: Requires PvpPower.Enable = 1. A chestpiece with PvP Power (+42) adds 42 x 0.05% = 2.1% to a level 60 High-Risk player's damage against a creature and removes 2.1% from the damage that creature deals, in the open world. Without the High-Risk aura it changes nothing.

steps.label: Without High Risk PvP Power deals base damage to a creature
Without High Risk PvP Power leaves creature damage unchanged
In High Risk PvP Power +42 raises damage dealt to a creature by 2.1%
In High Risk PvP Power +42 lowers damage taken from a creature by 2.1%
